quote: Broth dilution assays showed that the MIC and MBC values of ALE against A. hydrophila were both 8 μg/mL, indicating its potent antibacterial efficacy.
statement: 肉汤稀释试验显示，ALE对嗜水气单胞菌的最小抑菌浓度（MIC）和最小杀菌浓度（MBC）均为8 μg/mL，表明其具有强效的抗菌活性。
text_zh: 肉汤稀释试验显示，ALE对嗜水气单胞菌的最小抑菌浓度（MIC）和最小杀菌浓度（MBC）均为8 μg/mL，表明其具有强效的抗菌活性。
text_en: Broth dilution tests showed that the minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) and minimum bactericidal concentration (MBC) of ALE against Aeromonas hydrophila were both 8 μg/mL, indicating its strong antibacterial activity.

quote: time-kill kinetics analysis revealed that ALE exhibited rapid bactericidal activity, achieving complete bacterial eradication within 1 h
statement: 时间-杀菌动力学分析显示，ALE表现出快速的杀菌活性，在1小时内实现了完全的细菌根除。
text_zh: 时间-杀菌动力学分析显示，ALE表现出快速的杀菌活性，在1小时内实现了完全的细菌根除。
text_en: Time-kill kinetics analysis showed that ALE exhibited rapid bactericidal activity, achieving complete bacterial eradication within 1 hour.

quote: Histopathological examination was conducted to evaluate the safety of ALE-enriched diets after one week of administration.
statement: 对ALE富集饲料进行组织病理学检查以评估其安全性。
text_zh: 对ALE富集饲料进行组织病理学检查以评估其安全性。
text_en: Histopathological examination of ALE-enriched feed was conducted to assess its safety.

quote: However, hemosiderin deposition in the kidney was observed in both treatment groups (Figure 14 , green square).
statement: 然而，在两个处理组中均观察到肾脏含铁血黄素沉积。
text_zh: 然而，在两个处理组中均观察到肾脏含铁血黄素沉积。
text_en: However, renal hemosiderin deposition was observed in both treatment groups.

quote: In intestinal tissue, no remarkable changes were detected in the low group (16 mg/kg), whereas a noticeable increase in the number of goblet cells was evident in the high group (32 mg/kg) (Figure 14 , black square).
statement: 在肠道组织中，低剂量组（16 mg/kg）未检测到显著变化，而高剂量组（32 mg/kg）杯状细胞数量明显增加。
text_zh: 在肠道组织中，低剂量组（16 mg/kg）未检测到显著变化，而高剂量组（32 mg/kg）杯状细胞数量明显增加。
text_en: In intestinal tissue, no significant changes were detected in the low-dose group (16 mg/kg), while the number of goblet cells increased significantly in the high-dose group (32 mg/kg).

quote: ALE, an organosulfur compound derived from the bioactive compound (allicin) formed from crushed garlic, is widely recognized for its potent antibacterial properties [ 18 , 19 ].
statement: 大蒜素E是一种源自压碎大蒜中形成的生物活性化合物（大蒜素）的有机硫化合物，因其强效抗菌特性而被广泛认可。
text_zh: 大蒜素E是一种源自压碎大蒜中形成的生物活性化合物（大蒜素）的有机硫化合物，因其强效抗菌特性而被广泛认可。
text_en: Allicin E is an organosulfur compound derived from allicin, a bioactive compound formed in crushed garlic, and is widely recognized for its potent antibacterial properties.

quote: However, its efficacy and precise mechanism of action against key aquaculture pathogens such as A. hydrophila remain inadequately elucidated.
statement: 然而，其对嗜水气单胞菌等关键水产养殖病原体的功效和精确作用机制仍未得到充分阐明。
text_zh: 然而，其对嗜水气单胞菌等关键水产养殖病原体的功效和精确作用机制仍未得到充分阐明。
text_en: However, its efficacy and precise mechanism of action against key aquaculture pathogens such as Aeromonas hydrophila have not been fully elucidated.
limitations: 功效和机制未充分阐明

quote: This study aims to comprehensively evaluate the potential of ALE as a novel therapeutic agent against A. hydrophila .
statement: 本研究旨在全面评估大蒜素E作为对抗嗜水气单胞菌的新型治疗剂的潜力。
text_zh: 本研究旨在全面评估大蒜素E作为对抗嗜水气单胞菌的新型治疗剂的潜力。
text_en: This study aims to comprehensively evaluate the potential of allicin E as a novel therapeutic agent against Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: Furthermore, we elucidate its multifaceted mechanism of action, encompassing both bacterial membrane disruption and induction of oxidative stress, alongside its capacity to enhance host immunity in Carassius auratus gibelio .
statement: 此外，我们阐明其多方面的作用机制，包括细菌膜破坏和氧化应激诱导，以及其在银鲫中增强宿主免疫的能力。
text_zh: 此外，我们阐明其多方面的作用机制，包括细菌膜破坏和氧化应激诱导，以及其在银鲫中增强宿主免疫的能力。
text_en: In addition, we elucidated its multifaceted mechanisms of action, including bacterial membrane disruption and induction of oxidative stress, as well as its ability to enhance host immunity in silver crucian carp.

quote: These results demonstrate that ALE enhances the antioxidant defense system in infected fish.
statement: 这些结果表明ALE增强了受感染鱼类的抗氧化防御系统。
text_zh: 这些结果表明ALE增强了受感染鱼类的抗氧化防御系统。
text_en: These results indicate that ALE enhanced the antioxidant defense system of infected fish.

quote: Treatment with ALE markedly reduced the area of inflammatory cell infiltration in the liver, spleen, and kidney tissues.
statement: 用ALE治疗显著减少了肝脏、脾脏和肾脏组织中炎症细胞浸润的面积。
text_zh: 用ALE治疗显著减少了肝脏、脾脏和肾脏组织中炎症细胞浸润的面积。
text_en: ALE treatment significantly reduced the area of inflammatory cell infiltration in liver, spleen, and kidney tissues.
outcome: 组织病理损伤/炎症浸润

quote: Furthermore, kidney tissue hemorrhage was markedly alleviated in the low group (16 mg/kg), whereas no significant improvement was observed in the high group (32 mg/kg).
statement: 此外，在低剂量组（16 mg/kg）中肾组织出血得到显著缓解，而在高剂量组（32 mg/kg）中未观察到显著改善。
text_zh: 此外，在低剂量组（16 mg/kg）中肾组织出血得到显著缓解，而在高剂量组（32 mg/kg）中未观察到显著改善。
text_en: In addition, renal tissue hemorrhage was significantly alleviated in the low-dose group (16 mg/kg), while no significant improvement was observed in the high-dose group (32 mg/kg).
counterevidence: 高剂量组(32 mg/kg)未观察到显著改善

quote: plant extracts have gained increasing attention as green, efficient, and low-toxicity alternatives in aquaculture, recognized for their capacity to promote growth, strengthen immune responses, and enhance disease resistance in fish
statement: 植物提取物在水产养殖中因其促进生长、增强免疫反应和提高鱼类抗病能力的能力而受到关注。
text_zh: 植物提取物在水产养殖中因其促进生长、增强免疫反应和提高鱼类抗病能力的能力而受到关注。
text_en: Plant extracts have attracted attention in aquaculture due to their ability to promote growth, enhance immune responses, and improve fish disease resistance.

quote: ALE, an allicin derivative, has demonstrated potent antibacterial activity.
statement: 大蒜素衍生物ALE表现出强效的抗菌活性。
text_zh: 大蒜素衍生物ALE表现出强效的抗菌活性。
text_en: The allicin derivative ALE exhibits strong antibacterial activity.

quote: Consistent with previous reports on the benefits of phytogenic supplements in aquaculture, dietary incorporation of ALE conferred significant protection against A. hydrophila challenge.
statement: 日粮中添加ALE为鲫鱼提供了针对嗜水气单胞菌攻击的显著保护。
text_zh: 日粮中添加ALE为鲫鱼提供了针对嗜水气单胞菌攻击的显著保护。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with ALE provided significant protection against Aeromonas hydrophila attack in crucian carp.

quote: The low dose of ALE (16 mg/kg) significantly increased the survival rate of infected fish.
statement: 低剂量（16 mg/kg）的ALE显著提高了感染鱼的存活率。
text_zh: 低剂量（16 mg/kg）的ALE显著提高了感染鱼的存活率。
text_en: Low dose (16 mg/kg) of ALE significantly improved the survival rate of infected fish.

quote: Furthermore, ALE treatment led to a marked reduction in bacterial loads in key tissues such as the liver and kidney, providing direct evidence of its in vivo antibacterial action.
statement: ALE处理导致肝脏和肾脏等关键组织中的细菌载量显著降低，为其体内抗菌作用提供了直接证据。
text_zh: ALE处理导致肝脏和肾脏等关键组织中的细菌载量显著降低，为其体内抗菌作用提供了直接证据。
text_en: ALE treatment led to a significant reduction in bacterial load in key tissues such as the liver and kidney, providing direct evidence of its antibacterial action in vivo.

quote: The low group (16 mg/kg) showed a marked downregulation in the expression of these genes (p
statement: 低剂量组（16 mg/kg）显示这些炎症相关基因的表达显著下调。
text_zh: 低剂量组（16 mg/kg）显示这些炎症相关基因的表达显著下调。
text_en: The low-dose group (16 mg/kg) showed significantly downregulated expression of these inflammation-related genes.

quote: In contrast, the low ALE-treated group maintained significantly higher IgM concentrations, suggesting a supportive effect on the specific antibody response amidst inflammatory stress.
statement: 相比之下，低剂量ALE处理组维持了显著更高的IgM浓度，表明其在炎症应激下对特异性抗体反应具有支持作用。
text_zh: 相比之下，低剂量ALE处理组维持了显著更高的IgM浓度，表明其在炎症应激下对特异性抗体反应具有支持作用。
text_en: In contrast, the low-dose ALE treatment group maintained significantly higher IgM concentrations, indicating a supportive effect on specific antibody responses under inflammatory stress.

quote: Critically, ALE treatment effectively ameliorated this oxidative burden.
statement: 关键的是，ALE处理有效地改善了这种氧化负担。
text_zh: 关键的是，ALE处理有效地改善了这种氧化负担。
text_en: Crucially, ALE treatment effectively improved this oxidative burden.

quote: Fish receiving the low-dose ALE diet maintained significantly higher T-SOD activity and exhibited a more robust CAT response compared to the infected model group, demonstrating that ALE enhances the overall antioxidant capacity to mitigate infection-induced oxidative damage.
statement: 与感染模型组相比，接受低剂量ALE饲料的鱼维持了显著更高的T-SOD活性并表现出更稳健的CAT反应，证明ALE增强了整体抗氧化能力以减轻感染诱导的氧化损伤。
text_zh: 与感染模型组相比，接受低剂量ALE饲料的鱼维持了显著更高的T-SOD活性并表现出更稳健的CAT反应，证明ALE增强了整体抗氧化能力以减轻感染诱导的氧化损伤。
text_en: Compared to the infection model group, fish receiving the low-dose ALE diet maintained significantly higher T-SOD activity and exhibited a more robust CAT response, demonstrating that ALE enhanced overall antioxidant capacity to mitigate infection-induced oxidative damage.

quote: Following bacterial challenge, fish receiving the low-dose ALE (16 mg/kg) demonstrated significantly attenuated inflammatory responses across multiple tissues and a notable reduction in renal hemorrhage compared to the infected model group, indicating that ALE can alleviate bacteria-induced inflammatory responses and exert favorable tissue-protective effects.
statement: 在细菌攻击后，与感染模型组相比，接受低剂量ALE（16 mg/kg）的鱼在多个组织中表现出显著减弱的炎症反应和肾脏出血的明显减少，表明ALE可以缓解细菌诱导的炎症反应并发挥有利的组织保护作用。
text_zh: 在细菌攻击后，与感染模型组相比，接受低剂量ALE（16 mg/kg）的鱼在多个组织中表现出显著减弱的炎症反应和肾脏出血的明显减少，表明ALE可以缓解细菌诱导的炎症反应并发挥有利的组织保护作用。
text_en: After bacterial attack, compared with the infection model group, fish receiving low-dose ALE (16 mg/kg) showed significantly attenuated inflammatory responses in multiple tissues and a clear reduction in renal hemorrhage, indicating that ALE can alleviate bacteria-induced inflammation and exert favorable tissue protective effects.

quote: In summary, ALE can reduce the bacterial load in fish to alleviate the inflammatory response caused by A. hydrophila and mitigate fish tissue damage.
statement: 总之，ALE可以降低鱼体内的细菌载量，从而缓解由嗜水气单胞菌引起的炎症反应并减轻鱼体组织损伤。
text_zh: 总之，ALE可以降低鱼体内的细菌载量，从而缓解由嗜水气单胞菌引起的炎症反应并减轻鱼体组织损伤。
text_en: In conclusion, ALE can reduce the bacterial load in fish, thereby alleviating inflammatory responses caused by Aeromonas hydrophila and reducing tissue damage in fish.
outcome: 细菌载量/炎症/组织损伤

quote: These results indicated that ALE possesses potent and rapid bactericidal activity with a low potential for inducing resistance in A. hydrophila .
statement: ALE对嗜水气单胞菌具有强效且快速的杀菌活性，且诱导耐药性的潜力较低。
text_zh: ALE对嗜水气单胞菌具有强效且快速的杀菌活性，且诱导耐药性的潜力较低。
text_en: ALE has potent and rapid bactericidal activity against Aeromonas hydrophila, with a low potential to induce resistance.
outcome: 疾病控制与耐药性风险

quote: A dietary dose of 16 mg/kg significantly reduced bacterial loads in tissues, attenuated inflammatory responses, and alleviated histopathological damage in the fish.
statement: 日粮剂量为16 mg/kg时，显著降低了鱼体内的细菌载量，减轻了炎症反应，并缓解了组织病理损伤。
text_zh: 日粮剂量为16 mg/kg时，显著降低了鱼体内的细菌载量，减轻了炎症反应，并缓解了组织病理损伤。
text_en: At a dietary dose of 16 mg/kg, it significantly reduced the bacterial load in fish, alleviated inflammatory responses, and mitigated histopathological damage.

quote: The challenge test of A. hydrophila in C. auratus gibelio fish demonstrated that ALE has strong protection against A. hydrophila infection.
statement: 在鲤鲫（C. auratus gibelio）鱼中进行的气单胞菌（A. hydrophila）攻毒试验表明，ALE对气单胞菌感染具有强保护作用。
text_zh: 在鲤鲫（C. auratus gibelio）鱼中进行的气单胞菌（A. hydrophila）攻毒试验表明，ALE对气单胞菌感染具有强保护作用。
text_en: Challenge tests with Aeromonas hydrophila in crucian carp (C. auratus gibelio) showed that ALE has strong protective effects against A. hydrophila infection.

quote: Meanwhile, the increased LZM content before challenge (0 h) indicates that ALE may enhance the immune regulation of fish.
statement: Increased lysozyme (LZM) content before challenge suggests that ALE may enhance immune regulation in fish.
text_en: Increased lysozyme (LZM) content before challenge suggests that ALE may enhance immune regulation in fish.

quote: Importantly, one-week dietary administration of ALE revealed that the low dose (16 mg/kg) did not induce significant pathological alterations.
statement: One-week dietary administration of a low dose of ALE (16 mg/kg) did not cause significant pathological changes.
text_en: One-week dietary administration of a low dose of ALE (16 mg/kg) did not cause significant pathological changes.

quote: However, the high group exhibited increased hemosiderin deposition in renal tissue, suggesting potential erythrocyte alterations, alongside an increase in intestinal goblet cell numbers, which may represent a mucosal adaptive or irritant response.
statement: The high dose group showed increased hemosiderin deposition in kidney tissue and increased intestinal goblet cells, suggesting potential red blood cell alterations and a mucosal adaptive or irritant response.
text_en: The high dose group showed increased hemosiderin deposition in kidney tissue and increased intestinal goblet cells, suggesting potential red blood cell alterations and a mucosal adaptive or irritant response.
outcome: 肾脏与肠道组织损伤/应激

quote: Concurrently, ALE enhanced key components of humoral immunity and antioxidant defense.
statement: 同时，ALE增强了体液免疫和抗氧化防御的关键组成部分。
text_zh: 同时，ALE增强了体液免疫和抗氧化防御的关键组成部分。
text_en: At the same time, ALE enhanced key components of humoral immunity and antioxidant defense.
outcome: 免疫功能与抗氧化能力

quote: In our study, LZM activity was significantly enhanced in the low group, reinforcing innate bacterial clearance capacity.
statement: 在本研究中，低剂量组的溶菌酶活性显著增强，从而加强了先天细菌清除能力。
text_zh: 在本研究中，低剂量组的溶菌酶活性显著增强，从而加强了先天细菌清除能力。
text_en: In this study, lysozyme activity in the low-dose group was significantly enhanced, thereby strengthening innate bacterial clearance capacity.

quote: Following A. hydrophila infection, the intense infection suppressed IgM levels (model group).
statement: 在嗜水气单胞菌感染后，强烈的感染抑制了模型组的IgM水平。
text_zh: 在嗜水气单胞菌感染后，强烈的感染抑制了模型组的IgM水平。
text_en: After A. hydrophila infection, severe infection suppressed IgM levels in the model group.

quote: The fish were fed three times daily at 4% body weight for one week (8:30, 12:30, and 17:00).
statement: 鱼每天喂食三次，每次投喂量为体重的4%，持续一周（时间为8:30、12:30和17:00）。
text_zh: 鱼每天喂食三次，每次投喂量为体重的4%，持续一周（时间为8:30、12:30和17:00）。
text_en: Fish were fed three times a day, with each feeding amount being 4% of body weight, for one week (at 8:30, 12:30 and 17:00).

quote: The water temperature, pH, and dissolved oxygen concentration were maintained at 28–30 °C, 6.5–7.6, and 5.0 mg/L, respectively.
statement: 水温、pH值和溶解氧浓度分别维持在28–30 °C、6.5–7.6和5.0 mg/L。
text_zh: 水温、pH值和溶解氧浓度分别维持在28–30 °C、6.5–7.6和5.0 mg/L。
text_en: Water temperature, pH, and dissolved oxygen concentration were maintained at 28–30 °C, 6.5–7.6, and 5.0 mg/L, respectively.

quote: Before bacterial challenge, fish were fasted for 24 h, and 10 fish from each group were anesthetized with MS-222 (100 mg/L).
statement: 在细菌攻击前，鱼禁食24小时，每组10条鱼用MS-222（100 mg/L）麻醉。
text_zh: 在细菌攻击前，鱼禁食24小时，每组10条鱼用MS-222（100 mg/L）麻醉。
text_en: Before bacterial attack, fish were fasted for 24 hours, and 10 fish per group were anesthetized with MS-222 (100 mg/L).

quote: For the challenge experiment, 20 fish were randomly selected from both the low group and high group and intraperitoneally injected with a 100 μL bacterial suspension (1 × 10 7 CFU/mL).
statement: 在攻击实验中，从低剂量组和高剂量组各随机选取20条鱼，腹腔注射100 μL细菌悬浮液（1 × 10^7 CFU/mL）。
text_zh: 在攻击实验中，从低剂量组和高剂量组各随机选取20条鱼，腹腔注射100 μL细菌悬浮液（1 × 10^7 CFU/mL）。
text_en: In the challenge experiment, 20 fish were randomly selected from each of the low-dose and high-dose groups and intraperitoneally injected with 100 μL of bacterial suspension (1 × 10^7 CFU/mL).

quote: In aquaculture, inbreeding depression, poor management practices, and other factors can lead to a decline in fertility
statement: 在水产养殖中，近交衰退、不良管理实践和其他因素可能导致生育力下降。
text_zh: 在水产养殖中，近交衰退、不良管理实践和其他因素可能导致生育力下降。
text_en: In aquaculture, inbreeding depression, poor management practices, and other factors may lead to reduced fertility.
intervention: Water pollution, high density, improper practices
intervention_record: 水污染高密度不当操作

quote: The fish were fed in a 667 m 2 pond and fed twice a day (8:00 and 17:00) for more than one year
statement: 实验鱼在667平方米的池塘中饲养，每天喂食两次（8:00和17:00），持续一年以上。
text_zh: 实验鱼在667平方米的池塘中饲养，每天喂食两次（8:00和17:00），持续一年以上。
text_en: The experimental fish were reared in a 667-square-meter pond, fed twice daily (at 8:00 and 17:00) for over one year.

quote: Before the experiment, fish were anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, Sigma–Aldrich, Shanghai, China) dissolved in distilled water at a concentration of 80 mg/L.
statement: 实验前，鱼被用溶解在蒸馏水中的三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）麻醉，浓度为80 mg/L。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼被用溶解在蒸馏水中的三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）麻醉，浓度为80 mg/L。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) dissolved in distilled water at a concentration of 80 mg/L.

quote: The relative expression of target genes (IL-1β, IL-10, and TNF-α) was calculated using the 2 −ΔΔCt method, and β-actin was used as the reference gene,
statement: 使用2^-ΔΔCt法计算目标基因（IL-1β、IL-10和TNF-α）的相对表达量，并以β-actin作为内参基因。
text_zh: 使用2^-ΔΔCt法计算目标基因（IL-1β、IL-10和TNF-α）的相对表达量，并以β-actin作为内参基因。
text_en: The relative expression of target genes (IL-1β, IL-10 and TNF-α) was calculated using the 2^-ΔΔCt method, with β-actin as the internal reference gene.

quote: At 6 h post-challenge, 10 fish were sampled from each treatment group. The fish were anesthetized, and blood was collected from the caudal vein.
statement: 在攻击后6小时，从每个处理组采集10条鱼，对鱼进行麻醉并从尾静脉采血。
text_zh: 在攻击后6小时，从每个处理组采集10条鱼，对鱼进行麻醉并从尾静脉采血。
intervention: Tail vein blood collection after anesthesia
outcome: 应激反应/生理指标采样

quote: The remaining fish in each group were maintained for a three-day mortality observation.
statement: 每组剩余的鱼被保留用于为期三天的死亡率观察。
text_zh: 每组剩余的鱼被保留用于为期三天的死亡率观察。
text_en: The remaining fish in each group were retained for a three-day mortality observation.

quote: Model (n = 20) infected untreated 100 μL 1 × 10 7 CFU/mL bacterial suspension
statement: 模型组（n=20）感染未治疗，注射100 μL浓度为1×10^7 CFU/mL的细菌悬液。
text_zh: 模型组（n=20）感染未治疗，注射100 μL浓度为1×10^7 CFU/mL的细菌悬液。
text_en: The model group (n=20) was infected and untreated, injected with 100 μL of bacterial suspension at a concentration of 1×10^7 CFU/mL.

quote: the activities of key antioxidant enzymes, including lysozyme (LZM), total superoxide dismutase (T-SOD) and catalase (CAT), and the immunity index of immunoglobulin M (IgM) were measured using assay kits
statement: 使用试剂盒测量了关键抗氧化酶（包括溶菌酶、总超氧化物歧化酶和过氧化氢酶）的活性以及免疫球蛋白M的免疫指数。
text_zh: 使用试剂盒测量了关键抗氧化酶（包括溶菌酶、总超氧化物歧化酶和过氧化氢酶）的活性以及免疫球蛋白M的免疫指数。
text_en: The activities of key antioxidant enzymes (including lysozyme, total superoxide dismutase, and catalase) and the immune index of immunoglobulin M were measured using a kit.
outcome: 氧化应激水平/免疫功能

quote: Given that traditional morphological assessment of testicular development compromises fish survival, utilizing molecular markers to identify individuals with high fertility potential presents a promising alternative
statement: 鉴于传统的睾丸发育形态学评估会损害鱼类存活率，利用分子标记鉴定具有高生育潜力的个体是一种有前景的替代方案。
text_zh: 鉴于传统的睾丸发育形态学评估会损害鱼类存活率，利用分子标记鉴定具有高生育潜力的个体是一种有前景的替代方案。
text_en: Given that traditional morphological assessment of testicular development compromises fish survival, using molecular markers to identify individuals with high reproductive potential is a promising alternative.

quote: Diets containing TLM at 200, 600, and 1000 mg/kg were palatable to Atlantic salmon and were consumed at the same rate as the control feed.
statement: 含有200、600和1000毫克/千克土霉素的饲料对大西洋鲑适口性好，且摄食率与对照饲料相同。
text_zh: 含有200、600和1000毫克/千克土霉素的饲料对大西洋鲑适口性好，且摄食率与对照饲料相同。
text_en: Feed containing 200, 600 and 1000 mg/kg oxytetracycline was palatable to Atlantic salmon, with feed intake rates the same as the control feed.

quote: Treated fish grew as efficiently as the control fish, and post-mortem examination of all of the fish at the end of the study revealed no gross abnormalities
statement: 处理过的鱼生长效率与对照鱼相当，研究结束时的尸检未发现明显异常。
text_zh: 处理过的鱼生长效率与对照鱼相当，研究结束时的尸检未发现明显异常。
text_en: The growth efficiency of treated fish was comparable to that of control fish, and necropsy at the end of the study revealed no significant abnormalities.

quote: Fish were placed in fiberglass tanks supplied with 300 l dechlorinated tap water.
statement: 实验鱼被放置在装有300升脱氯自来水的玻璃钢罐中。
text_zh: 实验鱼被放置在装有300升脱氯自来水的玻璃钢罐中。
text_en: The experimental fish were placed in fiberglass-reinforced plastic tanks containing 300 liters of dechlorinated tap water.

quote: Oxygen content was kept close to saturation with air-stones.
statement: 通过气石将氧气含量保持在接近饱和状态。
text_zh: 通过气石将氧气含量保持在接近饱和状态。
text_en: Oxygen content is maintained near saturation using air stones.

quote: The fish were fed with drug-free normal feed for 7 days, then starved for another day before the beginning of the drug administration test.
statement: 在给药测试开始前，鱼先喂食无药正常饲料7天，然后禁食1天。
text_zh: 在给药测试开始前，鱼先喂食无药正常饲料7天，然后禁食1天。
text_en: Before the administration test began, fish were first fed drug-free normal feed for 7 days, then fasted for 1 day.
intervention_record: 给药前投喂与禁食准备

quote: Water temperature was maintained at 26±1 °C.
statement: 水温维持在26±1°C。
text_zh: 水温维持在26±1°C。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 26±1°C.

quote: About 2 ml blood was taken from the caudal vein of 5 randomly chosen fish at every sampling, ranging from 10 min to 168 h after oral administration. 1% heparin was used to prevent clotting.
statement: 每次采样从5条随机选择的鱼尾静脉采集约2毫升血液，使用1%肝素防止凝血。
text_zh: 每次采样从5条随机选择的鱼尾静脉采集约2毫升血液，使用1%肝素防止凝血。
text_en: For each sampling, approximately 2 mL of blood was collected from the caudal vein of 5 randomly selected fish, using 1% heparin to prevent coagulation.

quote: In order to ensure high quality crucian carp, prevention and treatment of these diseases is imperative.
statement: 为了确保鲫鱼的高质量，预防和治疗这些疾病是必要的。
text_zh: 为了确保鲫鱼的高质量，预防和治疗这些疾病是必要的。
text_en: To ensure the high quality of crucian carp, prevention and treatment of these diseases are necessary.

quote: Lower resistance of TLM was observed compared with tiamulin, ampicillin and tetracycline used against A. pleuropneumoniae (Kucerova et al., 2011).
statement: 与针对胸膜肺炎放线杆菌使用的泰妙菌素、氨苄西林和四环素相比，观察到TLM产生的耐药性较低。
text_zh: 与针对胸膜肺炎放线杆菌使用的泰妙菌素、氨苄西林和四环素相比，观察到TLM产生的耐药性较低。
text_en: Compared to tiamulin, ampicillin, and tetracycline used against Actinobacillus pleuropneumoniae, lower resistance was observed with TLM.

quote: TLM and derivatives have also been used for treating gram-positive bacteria which cause diseases of aquatic species (Eli Lilly and Company, Lily Corporate Center, 1994).
statement: TLM及其衍生物也被用于治疗引起水生动物疾病的革兰氏阳性菌。
text_zh: TLM及其衍生物也被用于治疗引起水生动物疾病的革兰氏阳性菌。
text_en: TLM and its derivatives are also used to treat Gram-positive bacteria that cause diseases in aquatic animals.

quote: Podophyllum hexandrum ameliorates endosulfan-induced genotoxicity and mutagenicity in freshwater cyprinid fish crucian carp
statement: Podophyllum hexandrum improves the condition of endosulfan-induced genotoxicity and mutagenicity in crucian carp.
text_en: Podophyllum hexandrum improves the condition of endosulfan-induced genotoxicity and mutagenicity in crucian carp.

quote: Fish were exposed through aqueous medium to each of single sublethal concentration of endosulfan (0.05 mg/L), hexane, chloroform, ethyl acetate, methanol and aqueous extract (15 mg/L each) of P. hexandrum , followed by their combination for 96 h.
statement: 鱼类通过水介质暴露于单一亚致死浓度的硫丹、己烷、氯仿、乙酸乙酯、甲醇以及P. hexandrum的水提取物，随后进行组合暴露，持续96小时。
text_zh: 鱼类通过水介质暴露于单一亚致死浓度的硫丹、己烷、氯仿、乙酸乙酯、甲醇以及P. hexandrum的水提取物，随后进行组合暴露，持续96小时。
text_en: Fish were exposed via the water medium to a single sublethal concentration of endosulfan, hexane, chloroform, ethyl acetate, methanol, and the aqueous extract of P. hexandrum, followed by combined exposure for 96 hours.

population.system: 半静态水族箱实验系统

intervention_record: 植物提取物与硫丹联合暴露

quote: Blood samples were withdrawn by caudal puncture with heparinized syringes and peripheral blood smears were immediately made by applying two drops of blood on precleaned and grease-free slides.
statement: 血液样本通过尾鳍穿刺使用肝素化注射器抽取，并立即在清洁无油脂的载玻片上制作外周血涂片。
text_zh: 血液样本通过尾鳍穿刺使用肝素化注射器抽取，并立即在清洁无油脂的载玻片上制作外周血涂片。
text_en: Blood samples were collected via caudal fin puncture using heparinized syringes, and peripheral blood smears were immediately prepared on clean, grease-free glass slides.
outcome: 采样操作对鱼体的影响

quote: The mutagenic and carcinogenic action of various genotoxic substances, like endosulfan, also involves the generation of DNA reactive free radicals, which overcharges the endogenous antioxidant defence systems, characterizing oxidative stress.
statement: Genotoxic substances like endosulfan cause mutagenic and carcinogenic actions through the generation of DNA-reactive free radicals that overload antioxidant defenses, resulting in oxidative stress.
text_en: Genotoxic substances like endosulfan cause mutagenic and carcinogenic actions through the generation of DNA-reactive free radicals that overload antioxidant defenses, resulting in oxidative stress.

quote: In our previous studies, we have demonstrated the genotoxicity, clastogenicity and oxidative stress of endosulfan in freshwater fish C. carassius (Dar et al. 2014a , 2015).
statement: Previous studies demonstrated that endosulfan causes genotoxicity, clastogenicity, and oxidative stress in the freshwater fish Carassius carassius.
text_en: Previous studies demonstrated that endosulfan causes genotoxicity, clastogenicity, and oxidative stress in the freshwater fish Carassius carassius.

quote: These specimens were identified by Prof. A. R. Yousuf and were transported live in plastic jars to the limnology and fisheries laboratory, University of Kashmir, where they were subjected to a prophylactic treatment by bathing in a 0.05% aqueous solution of potassium permanganate for 2 min to avoid dermal infection.
statement: 实验鱼在运输后接受了高锰酸钾溶液浸泡处理，以预防皮肤感染。
text_zh: 实验鱼在运输后接受了高锰酸钾溶液浸泡处理，以预防皮肤感染。
text_en: The experimental fish received a potassium permanganate solution immersion treatment after transport to prevent skin infections.

quote: The fish stock was then acclimatized for at least 3 weeks to 1:1 diurnal photoperiod in artificially aerated 60 L glass aquaria (10 fish in each) with aged dechlorinated tap water (pH 7.6–8.4), and fed ad libitum daily with commercially available fish food
statement: 鱼类在人工充气的玻璃水族箱中适应环境至少3周，使用老化除氯自来水，并自由采食商业饲料。
text_zh: 鱼类在人工充气的玻璃水族箱中适应环境至少3周，使用老化除氯自来水，并自由采食商业饲料。
text_en: Fish were acclimatized for at least 3 weeks in artificially aerated glass aquaria, using aged dechlorinated tap water, and fed commercial feed ad libitum.
outcome: 应激控制/水质管理/摄食

quote: Every effort as suggested by Bennett and Dooley (1982) was taken to maintain optimal conditions during acclimatization: no fish died during this period.
statement: 在适应期间维持了最佳条件，该时期内没有鱼死亡。
text_zh: 在适应期间维持了最佳条件，该时期内没有鱼死亡。
text_en: Optimal conditions were maintained during the acclimation period, and no fish died during this period.

quote: ES: endosulfan (0.05 mg/L); HEPH, CEPH, EEPH, MEPH and AEPH represent the hexane, chloroform, ethyl acetate, methanol and aqueous extract (15 mg/L each) of P. hexandrum, respectively.
statement: 实验中使用浓度为0.05 mg/L的硫丹（ES），以及浓度各为15 mg/L的五加皮（P. hexandrum）的正己烷、氯仿、乙酸乙酯、甲醇和水提取物。
text_zh: 实验中使用浓度为0.05 mg/L的硫丹（ES），以及浓度各为15 mg/L的五加皮（P. hexandrum）的正己烷、氯仿、乙酸乙酯、甲醇和水提取物。
text_en: The experiment used endosulfan (ES) at a concentration of 0.05 mg/L, and n-hexane, chloroform, ethyl acetate, methanol, and water extracts of Acanthopanax gracilistylus (P. hexandrum) each at a concentration of 15 mg/L.
intervention_record: 植物提取物与硫丹联合暴露

quote: endosulfan induced MN significantly (p Table 5).
statement: 硫丹显著诱导了微核的形成。
text_zh: 硫丹显著诱导了微核的形成。
text_en: Endosulfan significantly induced the formation of micronuclei.

statement: 在48小时处理组中，与仅使用Endosulfan相比，添加EE-F1组分后总畸变率从7.69%降至5.82%。
text_zh: 在48小时处理组中，与仅使用Endosulfan相比，添加EE-F1组分后总畸变率从7.69%降至5.82%。
text_en: In the 48-hour treatment group, adding the EE-F1 component reduced the total malformation rate from 7.69% to 5.82% compared with using Endosulfan alone.

statement: 在72小时处理组中，与仅使用Endosulfan相比，添加EE-F1组分后总畸变率从9.09%降至6.66%。
text_zh: 在72小时处理组中，与仅使用Endosulfan相比，添加EE-F1组分后总畸变率从9.09%降至6.66%。
text_en: In the 72-hour treatment group, adding the EE-F1 component reduced the total malformation rate from 9.09% to 6.66% compared with using Endosulfan alone.

statement: 在96小时处理组中，与仅使用Endosulfan相比，添加EE-F1组分后总畸变率从12.14%降至8.25%。
text_zh: 在96小时处理组中，与仅使用Endosulfan相比，添加EE-F1组分后总畸变率从12.14%降至8.25%。
text_en: In the 96-hour treatment group, compared to using Endosulfan alone, adding the EE-F1 component reduced the total malformation rate from 12.14% to 8.25%.

quote: was created by tilmicosin (15 µg/kg) on six bacteria (Edwardsiella ictaluri, Edwardsiella tarda. Aeromonas sp., Aeromonas hydrophila, Aeromonas sobria and Pseudomonas sp.) isolated from channel catfish
statement: 替米考星（15 µg/kg）对从斑点叉尾鮰中分离出的六种细菌产生了抑菌圈。
text_zh: 替米考星（15 µg/kg）对从斑点叉尾鮰中分离出的六种细菌产生了抑菌圈。
text_en: Tilmicosin (15 µg/kg) produced inhibition zones against six bacterial species isolated from channel catfish.

quote: This distribution characteristic showed that TLM could be used for treating abscesses and lesions that may be caused by pathogenic bacteria in skin and muscle
statement: 这种分布特征表明，替米考星可用于治疗由皮肤和肌肉中的致病菌引起的脓肿和病变。
text_zh: 这种分布特征表明，替米考星可用于治疗由皮肤和肌肉中的致病菌引起的脓肿和病变。
text_en: This distribution characteristic indicates that tilmicosin can be used to treat abscesses and lesions caused by pathogenic bacteria in the skin and muscle.

quote: on each sampling interval, 10 fish specimen were sacrificed; 5 fish were processed for the chromosomal aberration (CA) test (0.05% colchicine treatment was given prior to 3 h of autopsy)
statement: 在每个采样间隔，处死10条鱼；其中5条用于染色体畸变测试（在尸检前3小时给予0.05%秋水仙素处理）。
text_zh: 在每个采样间隔，处死10条鱼；其中5条用于染色体畸变测试（在尸检前3小时给予0.05%秋水仙素处理）。
text_en: At each sampling interval, 10 fish were sacrificed; 5 of them were used for the chromosome aberration test (treated with 0.05% colchicine 3 hours before necropsy).

quote: Slides were prepared using the standard fish micronucleated erythrocytes method (Al-Sabti & Metcalfe 1995). Blood samples were withdrawn by caudal puncture with heparinized syringes
statement: 切片采用标准的鱼类微核红细胞方法制备。血液样本通过肝素注射器尾静脉穿刺抽取。
text_zh: 切片采用标准的鱼类微核红细胞方法制备。血液样本通过肝素注射器尾静脉穿刺抽取。
text_en: Sections were prepared using the standard fish micronucleated erythrocyte method. Blood samples were collected by caudal vein puncture using a heparinized syringe.

quote: Immersion vaccination has numerous advantages over traditional methods including minimal pain for the fish, lower labor costs, and time coupled with greater operator safety especially for large numbers of small fish.
statement: 浸浴免疫接种相比传统方法具有对鱼疼痛最小、劳动力成本低以及操作者更安全等优势。
text_zh: 浸浴免疫接种相比传统方法具有对鱼疼痛最小、劳动力成本低以及操作者更安全等优势。
text_en: Bath immunization has advantages over traditional methods, including minimal pain to fish, low labor costs, and greater safety for operators.
outcome: 动物福利（疼痛）与操作安全

quote: However, immersion vaccination also possesses drawbacks such as the generation of weak immune responses and a large amount of vaccine is necessary that can increase costs (3).
statement: 浸浴免疫接种存在产生弱免疫反应以及需要大量疫苗从而增加成本的缺点。
text_zh: 浸浴免疫接种存在产生弱免疫反应以及需要大量疫苗从而增加成本的缺点。
text_en: Bath immunization has the disadvantages of producing a weak immune response and requiring large amounts of vaccine, thereby increasing costs.

quote: The reduction profiles by effective concentration of methanol extract (10 mg/L) with endosulfan were estimated as 63, 65 and 71% for 48, 72 and 96 h, respectively.
statement: 在有效浓度甲醇提取物（10 mg/L）与内硫丹共同处理下，估计的染色体畸变减少率分别为48、72和96小时的63%、65%和71%。
text_zh: 在有效浓度甲醇提取物（10 mg/L）与内硫丹共同处理下，估计的染色体畸变减少率分别为48、72和96小时的63%、65%和71%。
text_en: Under co-treatment with the effective concentration of methanol extract (10 mg/L) and endosulfan, the estimated reduction rates of chromosomal aberrations were 63%, 65%, and 71% at 48, 72, and 96 hours, respectively.

quote: In the EtOAc group with endosulfan, fraction EE-F4 was found to be more effective as the highest reduction of 73% (0.05 mg/L endosulfan +15 mg/L EE-F4) was recorded after 96 h registering the frequency of 5.71 ± 0.27 compared to 12.14 ± 0.47 of endosulfan (0.05 mg/L) alone (Table 3).
statement: 在含内硫丹的乙酸乙酯组中，发现组分EE-F4更有效，因为96小时后记录了最高73%的减少率（0.05 mg/L内硫丹+15 mg/L EE-F4），其频率为5.71±0.27，而单独使用内硫丹（0.05 mg/L）的频率为12.14±0.47。
text_zh: 在含内硫丹的乙酸乙酯组中，发现组分EE-F4更有效，因为96小时后记录了最高73%的减少率（0.05 mg/L内硫丹+15 mg/L EE-F4），其频率为5.71±0.27，而单独使用内硫丹（0.05 mg/L）的频率为12.14±0.47。
text_en: In the ethyl acetate fraction containing endosulfan, component EE-F4 was found to be more effective, as a maximum reduction rate of 73% was recorded after 96 hours (0.05 mg/L endosulfan + 15 mg/L EE-F4), with a frequency of 5.71±0.27, compared to a frequency of 12.14±0.47 for endosulfan alone (0.05 mg/L).

statement: 在暴露时间为96小时的条件下，乙酯提取物-处理1（0.05 mg/L 硫丹 + 5 mg/L EE）组的总畸变率均值为8.54%。
text_zh: 在暴露时间为96小时的条件下，乙酯提取物-处理1（0.05 mg/L 硫丹 + 5 mg/L EE）组的总畸变率均值为8.54%。
text_en: Under an exposure time of 96 hours, the mean total deformity rate for the ethyl ester extract-treatment 1 group (0.05 mg/L endosulfan + 5 mg/L EE) was 8.54%.

statement: 在暴露时间为96小时的条件下，甲醇提取物-处理1（0.05 mg/L 硫丹 + 5 mg/L ME）组的总畸变率均值为7.47%。
text_zh: 在暴露时间为96小时的条件下，甲醇提取物-处理1（0.05 mg/L 硫丹 + 5 mg/L ME）组的总畸变率均值为7.47%。
text_en: Under an exposure time of 96 hours, the mean total deformity rate for the methanol extract-treatment 1 group (0.05 mg/L endosulfan + 5 mg/L ME) was 7.47%.

quote: Overall, the results revealed that endosulfan was potent genotoxic agent and column eluted fractions ME-F2 and EE-F4 effectively reduced the frequency of CA and MN when used simultaneously with endosulfan.
statement: 结果表明，硫丹是一种强效的遗传毒性剂，而柱洗脱组分ME-F2和EE-F4在与硫丹同时使用时能有效降低染色体畸变（CA）和微核（MN）的频率。
text_zh: 结果表明，硫丹是一种强效的遗传毒性剂，而柱洗脱组分ME-F2和EE-F4在与硫丹同时使用时能有效降低染色体畸变（CA）和微核（MN）的频率。
text_en: The results showed that endosulfan is a potent genotoxic agent, while the plant extract column elution fractions ME-F2 and EE-F4 effectively reduced the frequency of chromosomal aberrations (CA) and micronuclei (MN) when used simultaneously with endosulfan.

quote: Similarly, in the case of endosulfan groups treated with EtOAc fractions (EE-1, 2, 3, 4 and 5; 15 mg/L each), the reduction profiles in the MN incidence were recorded as 46, 54, 58, 61, 42% (48 h); 42, 52, 56, 70, 44% (72 h) and 36, 51, 55, 72, 47% (96 h) (Table 6).
statement: 乙酸乙酯柱洗脱组分（EE-1至EE-5，各15 mg/L）与硫丹联合处理时，对微核发生率的降低幅度在48小时为42-61%，72小时为42-70%，96小时为36-72%不等。
text_zh: 乙酸乙酯柱洗脱组分（EE-1至EE-5，各15 mg/L）与硫丹联合处理时，对微核发生率的降低幅度在48小时为42-61%，72小时为42-70%，96小时为36-72%不等。
text_en: When ethyl acetate column elution fractions (EE-1 to EE-5, each at 15 mg/L) were co-treated with endosulfan, the reduction in micronucleus incidence ranged from 42-61% at 48 hours, 42-70% at 72 hours, and 36-72% at 96 hours.

quote: The bacterial suspension (1.8 × 10 9 CFU/ml) was diluted five times continuously with sterile physiological saline, then the crucian carp and grouper were injected intraperitoneally with 5 0 to 5 −4 dilution bacterial suspension at a dose of 0.2 ml/tail.
statement: 鲫鱼和石斑鱼腹腔注射了不同稀释度的细菌悬液，剂量为每尾0.2毫升。
text_zh: 鲫鱼和石斑鱼腹腔注射了不同稀释度的细菌悬液，剂量为每尾0.2毫升。
text_en: Crucian carp and grouper were intraperitoneally injected with bacterial suspensions of different dilutions, at a dose of 0.2 mL per fish.
outcome: 免疫保护效果与疾病挑战

quote: During the test, the water temperature was 28 ± 1°C.
statement: 测试期间水温控制在28±1°C。
text_zh: 测试期间水温控制在28±1°C。
text_en: During the test period, water temperature was controlled at 28±1°C.

quote: The protective function of the V. harveyi vaccination was examined using 20 fish from each group at 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 weeks following vaccination.
statement: V. harveyi疫苗接种的保护功能在接种后第1、2、3、4和5周通过每组20条鱼进行了检测。
text_zh: V. harveyi疫苗接种的保护功能在接种后第1、2、3、4和5周通过每组20条鱼进行了检测。
text_en: The protective function of V. harveyi vaccination was tested at weeks 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 post-vaccination using 20 fish per group.

quote: The fish were randomly selected and received 0.2 ml of 1.2 × 10 8 CFU/ml of V. harveyi by intraperitoneal injection.
statement: 随机选取的鱼通过腹腔注射接受了0.2毫升浓度为1.2 × 10^8 CFU/ml的哈维氏弧菌。
text_zh: 随机选取的鱼通过腹腔注射接受了0.2毫升浓度为1.2 × 10^8 CFU/ml的哈维氏弧菌。
text_en: Randomly selected fish received an intraperitoneal injection of 0.2 ml of Vibrio harveyi at a concentration of 1.2 × 10^8 CFU/ml.

quote: The fish were maintained for 2 weeks with a tank temperature of 28 ± 1°C and monitored for signs of morbidity and mortality.
statement: 鱼在水箱温度28 ± 1°C的条件下饲养2周，并监测发病和死亡迹象。
text_zh: 鱼在水箱温度28 ± 1°C的条件下饲养2周，并监测发病和死亡迹象。
text_en: Fish were reared for 2 weeks in water tanks at a temperature of 28 ± 1°C, and signs of disease onset and mortality were monitored.

quote: The immersion vaccination protocol utilized 1.5 × 107 CFU/ml and a 30-min immersion time in 0.65% normal saline for crucian carp and 0.85% for grouper.
statement: 浸浴免疫方案使用1.5×10^7 CFU/ml的浓度，鲫鱼在0.65%生理盐水中浸浴30分钟，石斑鱼在0.85%生理盐水中浸浴30分钟。
text_zh: 浸浴免疫方案使用1.5×10^7 CFU/ml的浓度，鲫鱼在0.65%生理盐水中浸浴30分钟，石斑鱼在0.85%生理盐水中浸浴30分钟。
text_en: The immersion immunization protocol used a concentration of 1.5×10^7 CFU/ml; crucian carp were immersed in 0.65% saline for 30 minutes, and grouper were immersed in 0.85% saline for 30 minutes.

quote: The skin surfaces were lightly scraped with clean glass slides and resulting mucus of three fish per sample time and group was mixed.
statement: Skin mucus was collected by lightly scraping the skin surface with glass slides.
text_en: Skin mucus was collected by lightly scraping the skin surface with glass slides.

quote: Blood samples (0.3 ml) was sampled from the tail vein and allowed to stand at room temperature for 1 h and then incubated overnight at 4°C.
statement: Blood samples were collected from the tail vein.
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the tail vein.

statement: 在96小时暴露期间，与单独使用硫丹相比，乙酸乙酯提取物（EE）和甲醇提取物（ME）处理组的微核总数及频率均显著降低。
text_zh: 在96小时暴露期间，与单独使用硫丹相比，乙酸乙酯提取物（EE）和甲醇提取物（ME）处理组的微核总数及频率均显著降低。
text_en: During the 96-hour exposure period, the total number and frequency of micronuclei were significantly lower in the ethyl acetate extract (EE) and methanol extract (ME) treatment groups compared to endosulfan alone.

quote: The levels of IgM mRNA were up-regulated in all six tissues after immersion vaccination.
statement: 浸泡疫苗接种后，所有六个组织中的IgM mRNA水平均上调。
text_zh: 浸泡疫苗接种后，所有六个组织中的IgM mRNA水平均上调。
text_en: After immersion vaccination, IgM mRNA levels were upregulated in all six tissues.

quote: The most significant changes for both fish were seen in the spleen that were increased 93- and 36-fold for the grouper and the crucian carp respectively.
statement: 两种鱼中脾脏的变化最为显著，石斑鱼和鲫鱼的IgM mRNA分别增加了93倍和36倍。
text_zh: 两种鱼中脾脏的变化最为显著，石斑鱼和鲫鱼的IgM mRNA分别增加了93倍和36倍。
text_en: The changes in the spleen were most significant in both fish, with IgM mRNA increasing by 93-fold and 36-fold in grouper and crucian carp, respectively.
